title: World Bloom — With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail! — Episode3 Return Of The Zombie Show!

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!
meta.Episode: Episode3 — Return Of The Zombie Show!
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's training continues as they each pursue their dreams. When they're called over to SEKAI by Rin and the others one day, they find an expansive new land awaiting them!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Outside the Inn

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your past, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There was a time when I'd also given up on wanting to be around others...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right... Before you met everyone, you were putting on shows all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, because I'd fallen under the impression that no one would ever understand me or how I thought...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In reality, I wanted to do shows with others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But no one was able to understand my shows, which led me to think that I shouldn't even bother with them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And then, I met...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Meeting all of you made me realize that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And since then, I've changed quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So much so that I looked for ways in which we could keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...! Are you talking about Emu?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. In retrospect, what I did seems rather selfish.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
You guys get to keep chasing your dreams together because you worked up the courage to go talk to Emu's brothers.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And here we are now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I honestly couldn't be happier about how we're able to keep doing shows together like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All this may also apply to our zombies. They act all prickly... But deep down, they seem to want to be friends with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'd like to help them turn that wish into a reality.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just like how you all did for me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna help the zombies!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... But how do we do that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe... In our case, I suppose there's always only one answer. We need to do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do what...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, my zombie friends!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
What?! You again?!
Look, we're not telling you anything about that phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I'm here to ask you about something else.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you like to do a show with us?
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hm? Why are there so many plushies gathered here?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
They're doing a show!
And the plushies from Zombie Island are gonna be in it!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
What?! The zombies?
That sounds scary... But what's it supposed to be about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We have quite an audience here now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Ready!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You really caught us by surprise when you said that we're doing a show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we all know exactly what to do since this is a modified rendition of Potato Ghosts!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Zombies, are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah.
But...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: Maybe this isn't such a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: We agreed to do this after you told us over and over that we'd be able to become friends with everyone if we did... But I still get the feeling that they're gonna be scared of us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't worry! I'm sure they'll all be smiling in the end!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, shows have that kind of power. Please trust me.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We also need to thank you for allowing us to put on a show here on such short notice, Mr. Innkeeper.

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line:
Nah, that's all good.
I mean, shows and parties go hand in hand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, we'll get started.
A real zombie show with our plushie friends here.

rows.Speaker: Park Staff Member
rows.Line: “Director! We have a remarkably large audience today!”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line:
“Oh? Excellent!
Let's see what sort of demographic it is this time... Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP.”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line: “Those look like...zombies!”
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line:
“No...!
Stay away. You're never going to catch me!”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “Wait. We just want to... Ow!”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line:
“Oh, you went for quite the tumble.
Your head and arms appear to have fallen off... A-Are you okay...?”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “We're fine! I mean...”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “We're zombies!”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line: “I forgot! I need to keep running!”

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Haha. The zombies are funny!

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “CHOMP.”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line: “No! I got bit!”

rows.Speaker: Park Staff Member
rows.Line: “Director! A-Are you hurt?”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line:
“Owwwwwwww...
Wait, no... It doesn't hurt...?”

rows.Speaker: Park Staff Member
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line:
“Odd... That didn't hurt at all...
Also, they seem to have settled down all of a sudden...”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “CHOMP CHOMP. Nice to meet you... Greetings...don't hurt...”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line: “Wh-What?! Is this how zombies greet each other?!”

rows.Speaker: Park Staff Member
rows.Line: “Director... What if they just want to become our friends...?”

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Wait, is that true?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Hold on. That means when they bit me that other time...

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line: “Yes, that appears to be the case...”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line:
“Then, nice to meet you too!
CHOMP!”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line:
“Oh, thank you!
Hehe. Now we can nibble on each other as much as we like!”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “Yeah! CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And so, the zombies were able to spend Halloween at the amusement park and have a wonderfully fun time with all the guests.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The end...
Thank you all for watching.

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line:
That was a great show!
And the zombies were really cute!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yeah. Also, I guess they just wanted to become friends with the rest of us.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Now I feel bad about being scared of them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, why don't we finish things off by greeting all of you?

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a way of showing thanks for watching our show until the end. Of course, zombie style.

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Oh, do it to me too!
Here, I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
Um, CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your show made it possible for everyone to become friends, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad we were able to help them somehow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Plushie C
rows.Line:
Now it's my turn to say hi!
I'll bite you this time! CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The other plushies seem to be much less scared of the zombies now.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. Shows really are wonderful.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They're able to wash away any misconceptions that the audience has lingering within their minds.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And I'd like to keep putting on shows like this. Ones that transcend borders. Ones that can really bring people together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That kind of show.)

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Hey, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, sure! What's up?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: So, thanks for putting on that show for us. We were able to become friends with everyone because you did...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. No worries.
It was something I just felt like doing is all.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Still... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Also, you said you were looking for a phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: We've heard a rumor that someone in the harbor knows a lot about them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Can you tell us who?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah. They're...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We did it, Rui!
We got our next clue to finding that phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we can finally take our next step forward.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, let's keep doing our best and find that phoenix.
